problem.heading: No website, or an old one, sends customers to someone else.
problem.intro: People look you up before they call. What they find decides whether they pick you.

points.title: They can’t find you
points.body: If you don’t show up when someone searches, the business that does gets the call.

points.title: Your site looks out of date
points.body: A dated site makes a great business look closed, careless, or cheap. First impressions happen online now.

points.title: It’s hard to use on a phone
points.body: Most people browse on their phone. If the menu is tiny and the number is buried, they leave.

points.title: The upfront bill keeps you stuck
points.body: A big design invoice before anything is built is why many owners put this off for years.

offer.heading: Everything you need to look professional online. $40 a month to start.
offer.intro: No big invoice before work starts. We design it, you see it, then you pick a plan.

compare.note: “The usual way” describes common agency pricing in general, not any specific company.

offer.yearly: Pay yearly and get 2 months free on every plan.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.intro: Three steps. The free demo comes first.

items.title: Request your free demo
items.body: Fill out a short form about your business. No credit card, no commitment.

items.title: Review your design
items.body: We design a preview of your new site, ready as soon as the next day. Want a completely different look before you decide? Just ask.

items.title: Go live
items.body: Love it? Pick a plan and we launch your site. Not for you? Walk away. You owe nothing.

timeline.what: Send the short form. Takes a few minutes.
Your free demo is ready to review.
Pick a plan and we launch your site.

examples.heading: Designs built for local businesses
examples.intro: Sample designs for the kinds of businesses we work with. Yours is designed around your business.

risk.heading: See your design before you pay a cent.
risk.body: We build your demo first. Like it? Pick a plan. Not for you? Walk away. No cost, no commitment.

pricing.heading: Simple monthly pricing
pricing.intro: Every plan starts with a free demo. Pick a plan only after you’ve seen your design.
pricing.limitedTime: Limited-time offer: $0 upfront on every plan.

terms.title: Cancel anytime
terms.body: If you cancel before your first year is up, the design files are not included.

terms.title: Your files after year one
terms.body: After your first year, if you decide to leave, we export your site files and deliver them to you.

terms.title: Edits
terms.body: Complete includes free changes for life. On Starter and Growth, simple tasks may be free depending on how long you’ve been with us. Everything else is quoted at $20/hour, well below typical agency rates.

demo.heading: Get your free demo
demo.intro: Tell us about your business. We’ll design a free preview of your new site, ready as soon as the next day.

contact.heading: Questions first? Talk to a person.
contact.intro: Call, email, or send a quick message. We’re open 9am–10pm, 7 days a week.
